conviction_note: Peers that reported Jul-Sep 2026 after VFF last spoke (Aurora international medical +44% y/y, Canopy international +141%, both on Germany/Poland demand) plus Delta 2's ~15 tonnes of H2 supply point to revenue above a single-source $64.37m consensus that is flat on Q2. Against that: Aurora reports medical price compression, VFF has run +16% in 5 days and roughly +47% since July, and the bar has one source. So p_up is 57, not higher, on a 14-point abs move taken from the name's own median reaction (no usable chain). The scaled +1.96 and the findings sum of +2.0 agree in sign and size by coincidence, not by fitting.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus revenue $64.37m, EPS $0.05, release 07:00 ET 9 Nov, per EarningsWhispers (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/VFF, read 2026-11-06). That is ONE source with no second source agreeing and no company guide (VFF gives no numeric guidance: Q2 2026 8-K ex99.1, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001584549/000119312526341207/vff-ex99_1.htm), so every finding is capped small. Comparisons: Q2 2026 revenue $64.0m against $56.28m consensus, Q3 2025 $66.7m against $57.95m, and Q3 2025 adj. EBITDA $20.2m against $9.52m.
positioning_check: Short interest 4.92M shares and 6.1 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 settlement (massive.com, https://massive.com/quote/vff, page showing an Oct 23 2026 price). StockAnalysis gives an undated 4.55M and 1.9 days. Against roughly 120M+ shares after the June 7.5M-share registered direct, that is about 4% of shares: not crowded. Borrow fee 0.6% (curvedtrading.com/stocks/vff). The option chain is unusable: ATM spread 138% of mid, no skew, put/call OI 1.56 on only 1,031 contracts, so the market makes no directional statement through options. Tape: +16.0% in 5 days, +8.2% in 20 days, 30.6% below the 52-week high, 57.6% above the low.

findings.finding: Two peers' Jul-Sep 2026 prints, released after VFF last spoke, show European medical demand still accelerating. Aurora's international medical revenue was a record C$61.4m (+44% y/y, Germany and Poland, 'increased patient demand'). Canopy's international cannabis revenue rose 141% on Germany and Poland. VFF's own exports were a record $20.9m in Q2 (+74% y/y, +43% q/q, about a third of sales), and its Delta 2 expansion adds about 15 tonnes in H2 2026. Consensus revenue of $64.37m is essentially flat on Q2's $64.0m, so continued export growth points to a revenue beat of roughly 5-10%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Export-driven revenue beats have been bought. Q2 2026: revenue +13.7% over consensus, stock +13.94% (2026-08-10). Q3 2025: revenue +15%, exports +758%, stock +16.89% (2025-11-10). Q2 2025: stock +34.3%. One miss-like print, Q4 2025 (2026-03-12), fell 13.11%.
findings.why_not_priced: Three analysts cover VFF, and the consensus sits flat on Q2. Consensus has lagged the export ramp on each of the last three beats. If the peer read-through were priced, consensus would have moved above Q2's $64.0m after Aurora's 5 Nov and Canopy's 6 Nov prints. Part of it is likely in the +16% 5-day run, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Canopy Q2 FY27 8-K, 2026-11-06 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001737927/000119312526450716/cgc-ex99_1.htm): international +141% on Germany/Poland. VFF's own Q2 export figures and Delta 2 tonnage (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001584549/000119312526341207/vff-ex99_1.htm). Peer data is a proxy: no VFF Q3 number exists before the print.

findings.finding: Aurora's Jul-Sep 2026 release reports medical-cannabis adjusted gross margin down to 62% from 69%, which it puts down to Canadian reimbursement changes and 'competitive market dynamics'. VFF's CFO flagged on the Q2 call that prices could come under pressure as more producers enter the EU market. VFF's Q2 cannabis gross margin was 51% (+9 points y/y), so export price pressure could cap the margin and EBITDA side of a revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026's margin expansion (cannabis gross margin 51% from 42%) came with a +13.94% day. No resolved print in the baseline shows a margin miss on a revenue beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Aurora's margin data came out on 5 Nov, inside a week in which VFF rose 16%. A tape that had priced margin pressure would not have run like that into the print. Most of Aurora's compression comes from Canadian reimbursement, which barely touches VFF (Canada branded is adult-use), so the transmission to VFF is partial.
findings.independence: VFF Q2 2026 call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15419079500252160, 2026-08-10): the CFO flagged possible price pressure as more producers enter but said EU-GMP pricing remains strong. Shares a document with finding 1 (Aurora's release); the two are opposite lines of it, volume against price.

findings.finding: Consensus on VFF has under-modelled revenue on three consecutive prints. Q2 2026 printed $63.98m against $56.28m (+13.7%) and EPS $0.06 against $0.02. Q3 2025 printed $66.7m against $57.95m and adj. EBITDA $20.2m against $9.52m. The current $64.37m bar comes from the same thin coverage (about three analysts).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Each of those beats was bought: +13.94%, +16.89%, +34.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected another beat as a matter of course, the bar would have been lifted and the stock would not trade 30% below its 52-week high. The +16% 5-day run says some of it is being anticipated.
findings.independence: Reuters via Tiger, 2025-11-10 (https://www-web.itiger.com/news/2582875305): the Q3 2025 beat against a 3-analyst consensus. This is an inference from the pattern, not a new fact about Q3 2026.

findings.finding: VFF goes into the print up 16.0% in 5 sessions and about 47% since July (about $1.97 then, $2.90 at the 6 Nov seal), with no VFF-specific news on EDGAR in that time. Its only 8-Ks were the 10 Sep interim CFO appointment and the 22 Oct EVP M&A contract and date notice. The most likely cause is the sector's re-rating on Organigram's 3 Nov agreement to buy Aurora, which pulls part of a beat into the price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline carries no run-up for prior prints. The Q4 2025 print fell 13.11%, so a disappointment on this name moves double digits.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a claim that something is priced, not that it is missed. The sealed tape (run_up_5d +16.0%) is the evidence. Short interest is about 4% of shares, so the run is not a squeeze setup that would add fuel.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline tape: run_up_5d_pct 16.0. Walnut's July 2026 snapshot puts the price at $1.97 (https://walnutinvest.com/stocks/vff/forecast).

findings.finding: Canadian consolidation is live and VFF is set up for M&A. Organigram agreed on 3 Nov 2026 to acquire Aurora, at C$7.80 cash or 5.8626 OGI shares per Aurora share. On 19 Oct VFF signed Stephen Ruffini as EVP M&A through May 2028, with a 'good reason' resignation trigger that includes a change in control (8-K, 22 Oct). M&A commentary on the call could support the multiple.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior VFF print turned on M&A.
findings.why_not_priced: The Aurora deal is probably what drove the 5-day run (see the run-up finding), so most of this is priced. What is left is whether VFF says anything about its own role in the consolidation on the 08:30 call.
findings.independence: Aurora's 5 Nov 6-K describes the Organigram arrangement agreement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001683541/000110465926123048/tm2629080d1_ex99-1.htm). Shares that document with findings 1 and 2.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management guided qualitatively to stronger free cash flow and a growing cash balance through H2 2026, said Canadian and Dutch expansion capex is nearly complete, and noted a 'balanced approach' to shareholder returns. H1 2026 operating cash flow was -$2.8m and cash was $73m, after a $15m registered direct in June and $7m of H1 buybacks. Q3 shows whether the cash build began.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 2025 print carried $24.4m of operating cash flow alongside the beat and rose 16.89%. Cash has not been tested as the deciding line on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus covers revenue and EPS, not cash. The June equity raise at about $2 is the last capital event the market saw, and a cash build with buyback capacity would undo that read.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 8-K ex99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001584549/000119312526341207/vff-ex99_1.htm): $73m cash, H1 OCF -$2.8m, 'grow cash from positive operating cash flow through the rest of 2026'.

findings.finding: The US federal hemp redefinition takes effect in mid-November 2026, and VFF's Q2 call noted only an extension for full-spectrum CBD products into December. Its US cannabis/CBD line (CBDistillery/BHB) was $3.2m in Q2, down from $3.8m and about 5% of sales, so an impairment or a wind-down comment is possible but small net of the rest of the company.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: the US line has never been the deciding line on a VFF print.
findings.why_not_priced: The rule is public, but the scale of any write-down on a small acquired CBD brand is not. At about 5% of sales, anything below operating income would be sized as a fraction of the same dollars as operating profit.
findings.independence: Q2 8-K ex99.1: US cannabis $3.2m against $3.8m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001584549/000119312526341207/vff-ex99_1.htm). Shares the transcript with the cash-flow finding.

findings.finding: Canopy's Jul-Sep 2026 print shows Canadian adult-use cannabis revenue +17% and Canadian medical +18% y/y. That is a firmer Canadian market than VFF's own Q2 showed (Canadian branded $23.0m against $25.0m, non-branded $3.0m against $7.1m), and management described Canadian pricing as plateauing. Canadian sales are about half of VFF's revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 had record Canadian net sales and margin alongside the export ramp, and the stock rose 16.89%. Canadian branded declined in Q2 2026 and was overshadowed by exports (+13.94%).
findings.why_not_priced: Canopy reported on 6 Nov, the day of the seal, and three analysts are unlikely to have updated VFF's Canadian line since. It is a peer proxy, and Canopy's growth may be share gains that do not transfer to VFF.
findings.independence: Contradicting point: Aurora's Canadian medical fell 24% on reimbursement changes (same Aurora 6-K), but VFF is mostly adult-use in Canada. A peer proxy, sized small.

outside_window.finding: Germany's MedCanG amendment (BT-Drs. 21/3061: a mail-order ban on flowers and an end to telemedicine-only prescriptions) had its first reading on 18 Dec 2025. No final Bundestag vote was found. It is VFF's largest export risk, but no dated vote falls inside the window.
Aurora/Organigram shareholder vote in December 2026, completion January 2027. Any sector re-rating from completion falls after the window.

baseline_tension: No usable skew exists. The peer evidence points up, and so does the name's history of bought beats (5 of 7 prints up). The +16% 5-day run cuts against it by pulling part of a beat forward, and that is why p_up sits at 57 rather than in the 60s.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar from one source): EarningsWhispers is the only source for the $64.37m consensus, with no company guide, so the largest findings are capped. Peer export finding 2.5 -> 2.0; consensus-lag pattern 1.5 -> 1.0; p_up 58 -> 57.
Rule 1 (reaction veto) checked and not applied: this name has bought its last three revenue beats (+13.9, +16.9, +34.3).
Rule 8 (thin coverage enlarges) not applied: no confirmed company-level Q3 number exists, only peer proxies.
Rule 5 / 9: the peer findings were already filed small as proxies and net of the Canadian business; unchanged.
